Second Chances & Replacement

New. Feeds on the moment someone steps into a role that isn't theirs by right — taking over for a dead sibling, a fallen leader, an absent parent. Grants uncanny competence at a borrowed job, and a nagging, permanent sense that you're still just standing in for the real thing.
